justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent initially understood "next Thursday, around 9 AM" as June 4th at 9 AM, but then offered times from 3 PM to 5 PM on that day, and later offered times on Friday, June 5th, which were also unavailable.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent repeatedly offered unavailable slots and failed to successfully book an appointment, even when the user explicitly agreed to an offered time.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeated the same question about available topics and contact mediums, and then repeated the same unavailable time slots multiple times.
justifications.customer_experience: The customer experience was frustrating due to the agent's inability to book an appointment, repeated questions, and offering unavailable slots.

judge_scores.overall_notes: The agent was unable to complete the core task of booking an appointment and exhibited significant issues with conversational flow and understanding user intent, leading to a very poor customer experience.
